# bdk-explain - the bdk-explain plugin

::: v-pre

Explains code, a flow or a concept as one self-contained, interactive HTML page opened in your browser, without leaving files in git status. Works alone, without bdk.

## Skills

### `/bdk-explain:explain` {#explain}

`/bdk-explain:explain`

Started by: you, or Claude when your request matches the description below.

Explains how code, a flow or a concept works as one self-contained, interactive HTML page - inline SVG diagrams, step-through or controls, light and dark themes - written to .bdk/tmp/explain/ (ignored by git) and opened in the browser. Load it when the user asks to explain or walk through something visually, as a page, a diagram, an interactive or visual explainer, or something to step through or play with, and on /bdk-explain:explain followed by a question.

:::
